猜疑（猜疑（第22页）他们没关灯，林江月透着被子看到一个佝偻的背影，还有影子腰间挂着的竹筒。大概停留了三息，灯被拉上，门又被关了。随后便听到“啪啪”两声，像是在挨打。但除了这两声，之后就没有任何声音了。这时，无寐丢了一个纸团过来。林江月看着纸上内容，思绪忽然明朗了。从身上也拿出笔纸写了起来。信丢了过去，借着微光，无寐朝林江月点了点头，没有再回信。这时，它们周围突然发生变化。肉壁开始起伏跳动，还有近乎于心跳脉搏的声音。又过了一会儿。“咕噜”“咕噜”好似肠道在吞咽什么。在肉壁的起伏下床也跟着摇晃了起来。但床却没有因此移动或漂浮。林江月弯下身子，发现床脚被打磨过，边缘处明显削尖了。这两张床、包括桌椅是被钉在了地上了！这种奇特的环境，让林江月的心理素质狠狠拔高了几层。她很难想象，自己有生之年会活在一头远古神兽的肚子里！而且，这头神兽体中可能还存在着其他物种。它这一次吞进来只有他们，但并不表示它之前吞进来的不是别的什么。还有一种可能。这只神兽知道自己腹中有活物。而且这些活物存活了至少百年。它这么做是为了什么？它完全不在意这些“食物”在它体内胡作非为吗？林江月正想着，他们房间的门又开了。一大包东西被塞了进来，阴影被拉长，覆盖了中间的桌椅。无寐翻了个身，背对着林江月。林江月则没动，身子随着肉壁上下晃动。门开的一瞬间，外面的声音被放大了许多。有撕咬声，还有打斗声。除了这些，那“咕噜”声也变得格外的大。……不一会儿，门关了。整个房间充斥着一股的香气，极富有诱惑力。林江月从被子里扯出两撮絮状物，拧成团塞进鼻孔。无寐不知道是不是真的睡着了，竟然对这股香气无动于衷。她塞好鼻孔，走进了那袋子。打开袋口，里面居然全是奶白贝壳果！这一大袋少说也有百来个。难道是门外那两个守卫送来的？不会，不可能。外面厮杀的声音那么大，肯定是跑了。那这些果子会是谁送来的？林江月将果子放进储物袋，又回到了床上。这些果子她本来也曾想晚上偷偷摸摸出去摘一些。哪怕是杀了那两个守卫。现在居然有将这些送上了门来。难道说这群里面还有异类？难道是那个想留下的罗依给她送的？

Suspicion (Suspicion (Page 22)) They did not turn off the lights. Lin Jiangyue saw a rickety back through the quilt, and a bamboo tube hanging around the shadow's waist. After about three breaths, the light was pulled up, and the door was closed again. Then two "pops" were heard, like being beaten. But except for these two sounds, there was no sound after that. At this time, Wumei lost it. A ball of paper came over. Lin Jiangyue looked at the content on the paper, and her thoughts suddenly became clear. She took out the pen and paper and threw it away. In the dim light, Wu Mei nodded to Lin Jiangyue and did not reply. At this time, there was a sudden change in the surroundings, and there was a sound that was almost like a heartbeat. "Gulu" "Gulu" seemed to be swallowing something. The bed swayed due to the undulation of the flesh wall, but Lin Jiangyue bent down and found that the legs of the bed had been polished and the edges were obviously sharpened. This strange environment made Lin Jiangyue's psychology. It's hard for her to imagine that she will live in the belly of an ancient beast! Moreover, there may be other species in the body of this beast. But it doesn't mean that it didn't swallow something else before. Moreover, there is another possibility. These living creatures have survived for at least a hundred years. Why does it do this? Does it not care about the mischief of these "foods" in its body? Just as Lin Jiangyue was thinking, a large bag of things was pushed in, and the shadow was stretched, covering the table and chairs in the middle. Lin Jiangyue did not move. The body swayed up and down with the flesh wall. The sound outside was amplified. In addition to these, the "gurgling" sound also became extremely loud. After a while, the whole room was filled with a scent, which was very tempting. Stuffing it into her nostrils. Wumei didn't know if she was really asleep, but she was indifferent to the smell. She stuffed her nostrils and walked into the bag. There were at least a hundred milky white shells in it. Could it have been brought by the two guards outside? It couldn't have been so loud. Run away. Who sent these fruits? Lin Jiangyue put the fruits into the storage bag and went back to the bed. She had originally wanted to go out to pick some of these fruits at night, but now they were sent to her by the one who wanted to stay.
